---
title: "Research"
---

My work spans theoretical and applied mathematics, with particular interest in problems where functional analysis, partial differential equations, stochastic methods, and computational approaches interact.

## Functional analysis and operator theory

Research on spectral and pseudospectral properties of operators and block operator matrices, semi-Fredholm theory, stability questions, and related perturbation problems.

## Partial differential equations

Work on local, fractional, and nonlocal PDEs, including Hardy-type inequalities, Kirchhoff-type problems, Pohozaev identities, and qualitative properties of solutions.

## Stochastic analysis

Research involving martingales, representation properties, stochastic equations, and related analytical structures.

## Scientific machine learning

Development and analysis of physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) and related methods for forward and inverse PDE problems, with emphasis on mathematical identifiability, model discrepancy, calibration, and comparison with classical numerical or statistical methods.
